The statute referenced is from the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA), specifically the employer sanctions provision. This provision makes it unlawful for employers to hire, recruit, or refer for a fee any alien who they know to be unauthorized to work in the United States. The legal implications of violating this provision are significant, as violators can face substantial fines and penalties. This serves as a deterrent to ensure compliance with U.S. immigration laws regarding employment eligibility.
